g.title: 'echo "SHA256 of the sorted unique characters: $(cat "$tmpfile")"' (414 us, 0.00%)
'grep -o "[A-Za-z0-9]" | sort | uniq -c | awk '\''{print $1, $2}'\'' | tee >(sha256sum > "$tmpfile") | << (SUBSHELL): 3328054 >> | wc -l' (12,994 us, 0.13%)
